page_notes.343: Slide-In Flanged Economy T-slot Stud table: 11 15-series rows extracted (5/16-18 Black Zinc and M8 x 1.25 Bright Zinc); 10-series 3115 and metric 19-89xx / 40-31xx / 40-3290 rows skipped.
page_notes.344: Drop-In T-slot Stud Assembly table: 5 rows badged 15+40 (13144-13148, mm dimensions) extracted; 30- and 45-series metric-only rows skipped.
page_notes.345: Drop-In T-slot Stud: 4 15-series rows extracted (Steel / Black Zinc merged cells); Drop-In T-slot Stud with Flanged Hex Nut table (75-36xx) is metric-only (30/45) and skipped.
page_notes.359: Ready Tube Fasteners page (Extended Tube Insert 4605/4607/4611, Anti-Rotation Plate 4625/4626): all product rows are RT-only, so nothing extracted; the only F row (3752) is suggested hardware for the RT-only plates.

corrected: 3116, 3851, 3120, 3852, 3126, 3853, 3134, 3854, 3288, 3857, 3290: description "... threaded length" -> "... stud length (D)" (column is D (Length), stud length under head, not a printed threaded length)
remaining_doubts: 3851/3852/3853/3854/3857 carry a 15 badge but an M8 x 1.25 thread; kept as 15-series per the badge.
13144-13148 are badged both 15 and 40 with mm dimensions; kept with series ["15"] only.
Category split (screw_bolt for slide-in and drop-in studs, fastener_assembly for the Drop-In T-slot Stud Assembly) is a judgment call.
